WithdrawPrice (merchandising). ACTIVE to WITHDRAWN; the item can no longer be quoted and ItemPriceWithdrawn is published. The same transition runs automatically when the item is discontinued (WithdrawOnDiscontinue). Transition resource: answers 200 with the withdrawn item price.
